title: Dashboard Layout & Per‑Page Layout
description: Build a persistent sidebar layout and apply it only to dashboard pages.
problemStatement:
## Goal
You will create a reusable Dashboard layout with a sidebar and apply it using the per‑page layout pattern.

### Requirements
1. Create a `components/DashboardLayout.js` component that renders a sidebar (a simple `<nav>` with links like "Overview" and "Settings") and a main content area where the page content goes (use `{children}`).
2. In `pages/_app.js`, implement the per‑page layout logic: if a page has `getLayout`, use it; otherwise, just render the page as‑is.
3. Create `pages/dashboard/index.js` (Dashboard home) and `pages/dashboard/settings.js`.
4. Both dashboard pages should export `getLayout` that wraps the page in `<DashboardLayout>`.
5. Add a separate page `pages/about.js` that does NOT use the dashboard layout.
6. Verify that navigating between Dashboard pages keeps the sidebar mounted (no flicker), and the About page has no sidebar.

### Bonus
Add a "Go to About" link in the Dashboard sidebar.
hints: For `_app.js`, use `const getLayout = Component.getLayout || ((page) => page);` and then `return getLayout(<Component {...pageProps} />);`.
Make sure the sidebar links use `next/link`.
expectedOutput: Dashboard pages share the sidebar layout; About page has no sidebar. Sidebar stays mounted when switching between Overview and Settings.
